mission:
SQ-066 WING-1: Mechanical conversion + glossary wiring (audit checklist 17 + 22). (A) Convert 4 legacy pages from raw-HTML markup to Markdown equivalents — ac-running-but-not-cooling.md, aux-heat-vs-emergency-heat-meaning.md, how-do-smart-meters-work.md, what-is-a-kilowatt-hour.md — translation rules:

T

→ '## T' (Hugo auto-generates ids; where an id was load-bearing for an in-page anchor, use '## T {#x}'),

→ ###,

text

→ plain paragraph, label → [label](/path), / → **/*,
    /
  • → markdown lists, blocks → markdown tables (preserve every cell exactly). ZERO wording changes — this is format-only. (B) utilities-glossary.md: convert the bottom 'full guides' plain-text list to real markdown links (the five hub pages + any listed guides — grep content/ for each slug to confirm the target exists; if a listed guide name matches no page, leave that entry unlinked and flag it in your envelope).
parent_objective: SQ-066: Execute all SQ-065 audit remediations — cloud-only formation
context: Why: the site's deterministic metrics tool counts markdown headings/links only, so HTML-marked pages read as false zeros (audit §0 tooling caveat); conversion brings tooling parity. The Commander has already edited aux-heat this session (fixed two broken H2s + replaced an intro) — convert from its CURRENT state. Do not touch how-utility-rates-fees-usage-work-together.md (excluded from your scope). After each file, verify with grep: no remaining '<h2|<h3|<a href' tags, heading count preserved (count ## before/after), link count preserved.
known_facts: These pages render fine today — the conversion must be provably rendering-equivalent (same headings, same links, same words)
Hugo shortcodes ({{< ... >}}) must pass through untouched
ac-running has 14 HTML H2 sections + internal <a> links per the audit; aux-heat similar
Glossary bottom list currently dead-ends five hub links' equity (audit §6 hub repairs)

resources.notes: grep counts before/after each file; quote them in the envelope.

constraints: You own EXACTLY these five files; format-only edits, ZERO wording changes (A) — glossary (B) may add links around existing words only
Chunked writes; verify tag-free result per file
success_criteria:
4 converted files: zero

/
